info.name: Open Exchange Rates Convert Currencies API

params.name: show_alternative
params.description: Set to true to extend returned values with alternative, black market, and digital currency rates.

params.name: show_inactive
params.description: Set to true to include historical/inactive currencies.

params.name: prettyprint
params.description: Set to true for human-readable response formatting.

items.docs: Returns a JSON map of all 3-letter currency codes available through the API to their full names. Requests to this endpoint do not require authentication and do not count against your account usage limit. Alternative currencies may not follow standard three-letter code formatting.
